decision_description: Resolved the embedded MSCA/ repository topology that D10 (milestone 1) deferred to D8. The MSCA vault was an embedded git repo referenced by the parent as a gitlink (mode 160000 at b4d9e570a0861fb49590015b2ff68afc3bb7181b) with NO .gitmodules registration — the 'worst of both worlds' state where a fresh clone of the parent gets an empty/broken MSCA/. DECISION: ABSORB the vault into the parent repository (track MSCA/** as ordinary files), rejecting the submodule option. Operator-confirmed 2026-07-16.

options_considered.absorb_CHOSEN: Remove the gitlink and track MSCA/** as ordinary parent-repo files. Pros: the vault is the tightly-coupled milestone-2 authoring surface of THIS repo (the compiler reads it and the projector mirrors state near it; cross-cutting compiler+vault changes commit atomically in one repo); ticket 5's generic-template home is naturally in-tree and its 'enable Dataview' step edits MSCA/.obsidian/community-plugins.json in-tree; the ticket-3 --from-graph path reads a stable in-tree path with no submodule init; ticket 9's throwaway second instances are cheap local config-bound vaults, not submodules with their own remotes. Cons: the standalone vault history leaves the live tree (mitigated by the bundle archive, below).
options_considered.submodule_REJECTED: Register MSCA/ as a real git submodule with a .gitmodules URL. REJECTED primarily because the standalone MSCA repo is LOCAL-ONLY: MSCA/.git/config has no remote/origin, so a .gitmodules url could not point to anything clonable without first publishing the vault to a hosting remote (an outward-facing decision not required by the mission). It also adds two-repo commit friction (every vault edit = a commit in MSCA + a pointer bump in the parent) that is exactly wrong for the tightly-coupled milestone-2 authoring work, and is heavier than a per-project config-bound vault needs to be.
options_considered.keep_gitlink_REJECTED: Leave the gitlink-without-.gitmodules state and only document it. REJECTED: it does not resolve the ticket (fresh clones still get an empty/broken MSCA/), leaving the exact state D8 exists to fix.

execution.denested: rm -rf MSCA/.git (the standalone repo's history is preserved in the bundle; MSCA is now a plain subdirectory of the parent).

It KEEPS .obsidian/plugins/ and community-plugins.json tracked so the vault is self-contained and Dataview can be enabled in ticket 5.
